findings.message: The tag holds 3 TSSE frames, where ID3v2.3 allows one; the second at 0x2F.
The ID3v2 TSSE frame names "other 2.0"; nothing in the stream confirms or contradicts it.
The APE Encoder item names "LAME 3.100", but the ID3v2 TSSE frame names "FFmpeg (Lavf60.16.100)"; other software may have rewritten the file, and kept one of them.
The APE Encoder item names "LAME 3.100", which writes MPEG audio, not DTS.
